room_name: Le salon de musique · The music room
note: painting repainted to replace the right-hand bookcase with a pink door with a gold teapot (to salon, Le salon de thé); alt updated; its 5 word cards recropped

room_name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
hook: "mee-lay-DEE": the butler bows low with a silver tray to the grand old lady: "Tea, MY LADY?": mee-lay-DEE ≈ MY LADY
note: Milady, my lady: old-fashioned or playful, from the English; a word for a grand English lady in old novels.

room_name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
hook: "SNOB": a man with a monocle holds his teacup pinky-up and sniffs at the plain biscuits: what a SNOB: SNOB ≈ SNOB
note: Snobbish, snobby: negative (elle est un peu snob = she's a bit of a snob); also a noun, un/une snob.

room_name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
hook: "ah-roh-GAHN": a vain man puffs out his chest and holds up a huge gilt portrait of HIMSELF for everyone to admire: ARROGANT: ah-roh-GAHN ≈ ARROGANT
note: Arrogant, haughty: negative.

room_name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
hook: "may-pree-ZAHN": a lady in a feathered hat sneers at a boy's little ribbon and holds up her own giant rosette: "MY PRIZE ON top!": may-pree-ZAHN ≈ MY PRIZE ON (top)
note: Contemptuous, scornful, condescending: negative (un regard méprisant = a scornful look).

room_name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
hook: "mah-loh-NEHT": a sneaky boy hides under the tablecloth and fishes the MARSHMALLOWS off the cake stand with a butterfly NET: dishonest: mah-loh-NEHT ≈ (marsh)MALLOW NET
note: Dishonest, crooked: negative (un commerçant malhonnête = a crooked shopkeeper).

room_name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
hook: "dees-TAHN": an aloof man sits alone on the far window seat watching the party through a long brass telescope: so DISTANT: dees-TAHN ≈ DISTANT
note: Distant, far; of a person, aloof, cold (il est distant avec moi = he's cold with me).

room_name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
hook: "boh-ay-MYAN": a free-spirited BOHEMIAN painter in sandals and a paint-spattered smock dabs the tea party onto his canvas: boh-ay-MYAN ≈ BOHEMIAN
note: A free spirit, an artist living an unconventional life (la vie de bohème). Old sense: a Romani person, now dated and offensive in that sense.

room_name: L'anniversaire · The birthday party
hook: "mah-tehr-nee-TAY": a happy mother in a rocking chair cradles her newborn baby in a soft blanket: MATERNITY: mah-tehr-nee-TAY ≈ MATERNITY
note: Motherhood; also a maternity hospital or ward (elle est à la maternité = she's at the maternity hospital) and maternity leave (un congé de maternité).

room_name: L'anniversaire · The birthday party
hook: "om-nee-pray-ZAHN": the birthday girl sits in a mountain of wrapped PRESENTS: presents on the chairs, on the shelves, everywhere: OMNI-PRESENTS: om-nee-pray-ZAHN ≈ OMNI-PRESENT(s)
note: Omnipresent, everywhere at once (la publicité est omniprésente = advertising is everywhere).

room_name: L'anniversaire · The birthday party
hook: "ee-nay-GAHL": a big dad sits on one end of the seesaw and a tiny girl dangles high in the air on the other: totally UN-EQUAL: ee-nay-GAHL ≈ UN-EQUAL
note: Unequal; also uneven (un terrain inégal = uneven ground) and patchy, inconsistent (une qualité inégale).

room_name: L'anniversaire · The birthday party
hook: "oh-dah-SYEUH": a bold ginger cat walks right across the party table and licks the birthday cake in front of everyone: AUDACIOUS: oh-dah-SYUH ≈ AUDACIOUS
note: Bold, daring (la fortune sourit aux audacieux = fortune favors the bold); can also mean too bold, cheeky.

room_name: L'anniversaire · The birthday party
hook: "an-pewl-SEEF": a boy can't wait a second and rips open a present that isn't even his, paper flying everywhere: IMPULSIVE: an-pewl-SEEF ≈ IMPULSIVE
note: Impulsive, acting without thinking: often a criticism.

room_name: L'anniversaire · The birthday party
hook: "an-fahn-TEEL": a grown-up uncle lost musical chairs and throws a kicking, wailing tantrum on the rug like a baby: INFANTILE: an-fahn-TEEL ≈ INFANTILE
note: Childish, immature (negative, of an adult); in medicine also of childhood (une maladie infantile = a childhood illness).

room_name: L'anniversaire · The birthday party
hook: "ah-tah-SHAHN": a fluffy puppy hugs a boy's ankle and stays ATTACHED ON wherever he walks: so endearing: ah-tah-SHAHN ≈ ATTACH ON
note: Endearing, lovable (un enfant attachant = a lovable child). Not 'attached'.

room_name: La salle de jeux · The game room
hook: "ah-noh-mah-LEE": a girl holds up the one bright BLUE banana from a bowl of yellow ones: a real ANOMALY: ah-noh-mah-LEE ≈ ANOMALY
note: Anomaly, irregularity; also a defect or fault (une anomalie technique).

room_name: La salle de jeux · The game room
hook: "ee-nah-bee-TWEHL": a bee sits wrapped IN a fluffy BEE TOWEL like after a bath, on the windowsill: very unusual: ee-nah-bee-TWEHL ≈ IN A BEE TOWEL
note: Unusual, out of the ordinary.

room_name: La salle de jeux · The game room
hook: "ROHK": grandpa belts out a ROCK song at the karaoke mic, but his voice comes out all raspy and croaky: ROHK ≈ ROCK
note: Hoarse, raspy, husky (une voix rauque = a husky voice).

room_name: La salle de jeux · The game room
hook: "ay-rah-YAY": a girl waves pompoms for grandpa: "eh, RAH! YAY!", cheering until her voice cracks: ay-rah-YAY ≈ eh, RAH-YAY!
note: Hoarse, cracked (une voix éraillée); of a surface, scratched or frayed.

room_name: La salle de jeux · The game room
hook: "op-say-syoh-NEHL": a boy kneels at the coffee table and straightens every single domino with a ruler, again and again: OBSESSIVE: op-say-syoh-NEHL ≈ OBSESSIONAL
note: Obsessive, compulsive (often negative); in psychology, obsessional.

room_name: La salle de jeux · The game room
hook: "ahs-tew-SYEUH": a girl smiles slyly and slides her knight for checkmate while her big brother gapes: so ASTUTE: ahs-tew-SYUH ≈ ASTUTE
note: Clever, astute, smart (une idée astucieuse = a clever idea).

room_name: Le studio photo · The photo studio
hook: "ans-tahn-tah-NAY": a girl gasps as a photo slides out of the camera that very INSTANT, already in color: ans-tahn-tah-NAY ≈ INSTANT-AY
note: Instant, immediate (le café instantané = instant coffee); as a noun, un instantané = a snapshot.

room_name: Le studio photo · The photo studio
hook: "ray-ah-LEEST": a painter shows a portrait of a fish so REALISTIC that the cat sniffs at the canvas: ray-ah-LEEST ≈ REALIST(ic)
note: Realistic, down-to-earth; in art, realist.

room_name: Le studio photo · The photo studio
hook: "eh-luh-VAY": the photographer climbs high up a tall stepladder to shoot the family from an ELEVATED spot: eh-luh-VAY ≈ ELEVA(ted)
note: High, raised (un prix élevé = a high price); also noble, lofty; and bien élevé = well brought up, polite.

room_name: Le studio photo · The photo studio
hook: "mohn-TAY": the assistant screws the big camera onto its tall tripod: firmly MOUNTED: mohn-TAY ≈ MOUNT-ed
note: Mounted, set up, assembled; also riding (la police montée = mounted police); un coup monté = a setup, a frame-up.

room_name: Le studio photo · The photo studio
hook: "POP": a teen in headphones blows a pink bubble that goes POP in front of a bright POP-art portrait: POP ≈ POP
note: Pop, as in pop music or pop art (la musique pop); does not change for gender or number.

room_name: La salle de gym · The gym
hook: "FREHL": a FRAIL little old man wobbles as he lifts a tiny pink dumbbell: FREHL ≈ FRAIL
note: Frail, slight, fragile (une voix frêle = a thin voice).

room_name: La salle de gym · The gym
hook: "mews-kew-LEHR": a MUSCULAR strongman lifts a huge barbell with two laughing grandmas sitting on its ends: mews-kew-LEHR ≈ MUSCULAR
note: Of the muscles (la force musculaire = muscle strength); for a person with big muscles French usually says musclé.

room_name: La salle de gym · The gym
hook: "vehr-tee-KAHL": a girl climbs straight up the rope to the ceiling: totally VERTICAL: vehr-tee-KAHL ≈ VERTICAL
note: Vertical, upright.

room_name: La salle de gym · The gym
hook: "pah-rah-LEHL": a gymnast swings between two PARALLEL bars, legs straight up: pah-rah-LEHL ≈ PARALLEL
note: Parallel (les barres parallèles = parallel bars); also unofficial, alternative (le marché parallèle = the black market).

room_name: La salle de gym · The gym
hook: "kohn-PAHKT": a boy squeezes his ball, towel, shoes and bottle into one tiny bag and zips it: COMPACT, all PACKED: kohn-PAHKT ≈ COM-PACKED
note: Compact, small and neat; also dense, packed tight (une foule compacte = a dense crowd).

room_name: La salle de gym · The gym
hook: "TEEK": the coach's eye twitches with every TICK of the big gym clock: a nervous TIC: TEEK ≈ TICK
note: A tic, a nervous twitch; also a habit, a mannerism (un tic de langage = a verbal tic).

room_name: La serre · The conservatory
hook: "fehr-TEEL": a gardener lifts a GIANT pumpkin out of the dark rich soil: so FERTILE: fehr-TEEL ≈ FERTILE
note: Fertile, rich (une terre fertile); also fruitful, inventive (une imagination fertile).

room_name: La serre · The conservatory
hook: "DAHNS": a boy pushes his way into a jungle of ferns so thick and DENSE he can barely get through: DAHNS ≈ DENSE
note: Dense, thick (un brouillard dense = thick fog); also heavy, packed (une circulation dense = heavy traffic).

room_name: La serre · The conservatory
hook: "ahn-bew-LAHN": a tortoise AMBLES along the brick path with a little flowerpot on its shell: ahn-bew-LAHN ≈ AMBLE-AHN
note: Traveling, itinerant (un marchand ambulant = a street vendor); walking.

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "tee-RUHR": a big uncle pulls the tug-of-war rope so hard it starts to TEAR: TEAR-ER: tee-RUHR ≈ TEAR-ER
note: Mostly a shooter or marksman (un tireur d'élite = a sniper; un tireur à l'arc = an archer); also someone who pulls. From tirer = to pull, to shoot. (gloss now leads with shooter, marksman)
